player_osd.ends_at.description: Player controls: the local clock time at which the playing item will end, shown beside the playback buttons. {time} is a 24-hour time such as 21:45.

player_osd.up_next.description: Player: label over the next episode on the card offered during the credits. Drawn in capitals.

player_osd.starts_in.description: Player: countdown on the next-episode card before the next episode starts by itself. {seconds} is a whole number of seconds; keep the unit as short as the source.
